### Vocabulary in scope

New at this step:
- quantity (also: Quantity) — it is necessary that each quantity is of exactly one kind of property (HCP L0 — Quantity: a magnitude of one fixed kind of property, with no bearer yet; massQ, springQ read PhysLib's oscillator mass and spring constant as kinded quantities)
- dimensioned kind (also: DimensionedKind) — it is necessary that each dimensioned kind carries exactly one dimension (HCP L0 — angularFrequencyDK (.kind, .dim))
- oscillator (also: black box) — it is necessary that each oscillator consists of exactly one body (HCP L0 — The black box: one body on one ideal spring to a wall)
- body — it is necessary that each body is the body of exactly one oscillator (HCP L0 — The black box)
- spring — it is necessary that each spring is anchored to exactly one wall (HCP L0 — The black box)
- wall — it is necessary that each wall anchors at least 1 spring (HCP L0 — The black box)
- oscillator mass (also: massQ) — it is necessary that each oscillator mass is read from exactly one oscillator (HCP L0 — massQ reads PhysLib's oscillator mass as a kinded quantity)
- oscillator stiffness (also: springQ) — it is necessary that each oscillator stiffness is read from exactly one oscillator (HCP L0 — springQ reads PhysLib's oscillator spring constant as a kinded quantity)
- mass — the quantity kind `mass` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- spring constant (also: stiffness) — the quantity kind `spring constant` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- angular frequency (also: angularFrequency, angularFrequencyDK) — the quantity kind `angular frequency` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- frequency — the quantity kind `frequency` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- *quantity* is of *kind of property* — verb
- *quantity* is read from *oscillator* — verb
- *oscillator* consists of *body* — verb
- *body* is the body of *oscillator* — verb
- *spring* connects *body* — verb
- *spring* is anchored to *wall* — verb
- *wall* anchors *spring* — verb
